claim: Point-in-time Census M3 Industrial Machinery backlog intensity can identify industry-demand states that improve the fixed fresh Industrial Machinery cohort versus XLI after costs.

source.authority: U.S. Census Bureau M3 original monthly full-report PDFs
source.shipments: Table 1 current report-month seasonally adjusted preliminary value
source.unfilled_orders: Table 3 current report-month seasonally adjusted preliminary value
source.point_in_time_requirement: use only values contained in the original release PDF and never later revised current-archive history

signal.rule: current backlog_ratio > arithmetic mean of previous 12 released backlog_ratio observations
signal.availability: state change effective on the first trading day strictly after the Census PDF release date
signal.hold: retain state until the next causally available release

cohort_return_definition: equal-weight arithmetic mean of adjusted daily returns of the fixed eight-name cohort; this is a frozen synthetic cohort index and does not claim historical constituent-selection purity

controls.matched_static: static mix of cohort index and XLI using the strategy's full-sample mean ON exposure

evaluation.pass_gate: full matched_excess_cagr > 0 AND full xli_excess_cagr > 0 AND at least 2 of 3 folds have matched_excess_cagr > 0
